title: A belt snaps on the grow lamps
text: The drive belt on the hydroponic lamps has snapped. Without light the beds will die this week. The only spare belt is on a workshop machine.

choices.label: Take the belt off a workshop machine
Let this crop die

title: People at the gate
text: Five people are at the gate. Their tunnel north of Atlantic Av collapsed and they have nowhere else to go. Five more mouths, and five more pairs of hands.

choices.label: Let them in
Keep the gate shut

title: The filters are clogged
text: Mara says the charcoal in the air filters is clogged and dust is getting into the passages. To clean it, one filter has to stop for a while.

choices.label: Stop one filter and clean it
Leave it running dirty (the filters work worse)

title: A quarrel on the platform
text: Jonah and Owen are shouting across the platform about who ate the extra rations. Everyone has stopped work to watch.

choices.label: Hear them both out
Send them both back to work

title: A sermon in the passage
text: Ellis is preaching the Synod's teaching by the filter room, and a few of your people have stopped to listen. Let it go on, and the Synod takes root on your station.

choices.label: Let Ellis preach (the Synod gains followers)
Break it up

title: A crate with no stamp
text: Fran has a crate brought in through Bowling Green. No stamp, no receipt, and it is worth good tokens. The Exchange traders will take a refusal badly.

choices.label: Take the crate
Send it back (the Exchange takes offence)

title: A rumble under the platform
text: Lila's dig crew has broken into a hollow and dust is pouring into the lower level. Props will cost materials. Dig on without them and someone will breathe that dust and fall sick.

choices.label: Put in props
Keep digging without props

title: A voice in the static
text: In the static on June's radio, or in a pipe that sounds like one, a voice says one word twice: "Floor". June asks whether she should write down what she hears.

choices.label: Have her write down every word
Tell her to ignore it

title: Traders with sacks
text: Benny waves in a handcar from the Exchange side. The sacks of food are real, but the price is steep.

choices.label: Buy the sacks
Let them through without a toll

title: Two bunks are empty
text: In the night two residents walked off into the tunnel toward the river. They left their name tags on their bunks. A crew could still catch them.

choices.label: Send a crew after them
Let them go

title: Spare cable
text: Mara's crew finds a spool of cable in a sealed locker: old Depot stock nobody remembers. Use it yourselves, or sell it.

choices.label: Take it to the workshop
Sell it to passing traders

title: A wet cough
text: Ruth and two others on the platform are coughing into their sleeves. Put them to bed and the cough may stop with them. Keep them working and it will spread.

choices.label: Put them to bed and lose their shift
Make them work through it

title: A drip over the bunks
text: Pete finds water dripping over the bunks. Left alone it will get worse, and when the flood comes the water will reach the rooms.

choices.label: Patch it with workshop cloth (protects from the flood)
Put out buckets and move on

title: Hal will not sleep
text: Hal can't sleep and walks the platform all night. The night shift says he is a danger at the machines and wants him kept away from the tools.

choices.label: Put him on night watch
Order him to bed

title: Owen counts the bowls
text: Owen counts the bowls twice: tonight there is one meal too few. Either everyone eats a little less, or someone goes hungry until tomorrow.

choices.label: Split what there is between everyone
Someone goes without, promise more tomorrow

title: Samira's drill walks off
text: Samira's drill is gone from its peg in the workshop. Someone borrowed it and never brought it back.

choices.label: Go room to room and ask
Let it go

title: Ada wants a curtain
text: Ada asks for a curtain between the bunks. It is a small thing, and everyone is waiting to see how you answer.

choices.label: Hang a curtain
Refuse: the cloth is needed for the filters

title: Nora tastes salt in the air
text: Nora tastes salt in the air by the east wall. There is a crack there, and the river is closer than the map says.

choices.label: Seal the crack
Write it down and leave it

title: Vic's scrap pile
text: Vic has gathered a pile of scrap. The workshop could use it, but Vic says it is his, and taking it will cause bad blood.

choices.label: Take it for the workshop anyway
Leave it with Vic

title: Rob won't leave his machine
text: Rob has worked two shifts in a row and will not leave his machine. The next shift is standing behind him with nothing to do.

choices.label: Send him off to eat
Let him finish the run

title: Tess starts a hymn
text: Tess starts a hymn in the passage. It is not a Synod hymn. People join in anyway.

choices.label: Let her finish
Ask for quiet on the platform

title: Paul's old route
text: Paul swears he can still drive a handcar to the ferry by his old route. That tunnel is not on your map. If he gets through, more stations will hear of you.

choices.label: Send him with a lamp and a partner
Keep him at the station

title: The beds remember the belt
text: The hydroponic beds still have not recovered.

by.fix: The new belt holds. The beds are back, and the crew knows who climbed in for it.
by.lose: The lost crop is still talked about at meals. The next belt looks worn too.

choices.label: Thank the crew in front of everyone
Get back to work

title: Back at the gate
text: Someone from that crowd is back at the gate.

by.take: One of the people you took in has family still outside. They ask if the yard can stand one more.
by.turn: The people you turned away left a mark on the gate. A child keeps calling their names.

choices.label: Promise to let their people in later
Write down the names and promise nothing

title: Mara opens the stacks again
text: Mara is back at the charcoal.

by.clean: Mara's crew still talks about the shift they stopped the filter to clean it. The dust is back.
by.run: Mara still tastes the dust from the week she left the filter running.

choices.label: Clean it properly this time
Live with the dust

title: Jonah and Owen again
text: Jonah and Owen are not finished.

by.hear: Jonah and Owen kept the peace you made, until the bowls came up short again.
by.shut: Jonah and Owen are louder than last time. Sending them back to work did not settle it.

choices.label: Sit them down to eat at one table
Put them on different shifts

title: Ellis asks for a room
text: Ellis wants a room for the talking.

by.allow: Ellis says the sermon you allowed needs a room now, not a passage.
by.stop: Ellis is quieter, and the people you pulled away from the sermon have not forgotten.

choices.label: Give Ellis a corner of the meeting hall
Keep the hall for everyone

title: Fran has another crate
text: Fran is back with another offer.

by.take: Fran says the crate you took opened a route. She can run it again, for a cut.
by.refuse: Fran tells the line you sent her crate back. The next offer is smaller, and colder.

choices.label: Take your cut and say nothing
Stop dealing with Fran (the Exchange takes offence)

title: Lila will not go back down
text: Lila stands on the platform and will not go near the ladder.

by.shore: Lila says the shore you built held. She still will not be the first one down.
by.push: Lila remembers being told to keep digging. She will not take the ladder.

choices.label: Send her down with a partner
Keep her on the upper level

title: June hears it twice
text: June has the word again.

by.log: June brings the page you told her to keep. The voice said Floor a second time.
by.ignore: June heard it again, after you told her to ignore it. She wrote it down anyway.

choices.label: Add it to the papers
Take her off the radio

title: Benny's traders come back
text: Benny's traders are at the handcar again.

by.buy: Benny's traders are back with more sacks, because you paid last time.
by.pass: Benny's traders are back. They remember that you let them pass, and the price has not improved.

choices.label: Buy a smaller load
Wave them through

title: A tag comes back
text: One of the name tags from the empty bunks has turned up at the station.

by.search: The crew you sent comes back with one tag and no person. The other bunk is still empty.
by.let: Someone left a tag on the gate. It belongs to one of the two you let go.

choices.label: Hang the tag in the hall for all to see
Put it away in a box

title: Ruth's cough moves
text: Ruth's cough is in another room.

by.beds: The beds you cleared held Ruth. The cough is in the next bunk now.
by.work: Ruth worked through it, like you asked. Two more people are coughing.

choices.label: Put the sick to bed again
Keep everyone on shift

title: Pete's drip is back
text: Pete is under the same pipe.

by.patch: The cloth held the first seam. Pete found one more, smaller.
by.buckets: The buckets Pete set are full. The bunks under them are not dry.

choices.label: Patch the new seam (protects from the flood)
Move the bunks away from the drip

title: A chain across the tunnel
text: Captain Rhee's men have strung a chain across the tunnel on the Jay St side. Every handcar that passes now pays the Directorate, and Jonah says they asked about your station by name.

choices.label: Pay the toll (the Directorate is pleased)
Pay in cable and bolts (the Directorate is pleased)
Send the handcars the long way (the Directorate is displeased)

title: Rhee brings a ledger
text: Captain Rhee is at the gate with a ledger. Jonah keeps him there.

by.pay: Rhee says the toll you paid was only the first instalment. Your station now has its own line in his ledger, payable every month.
by.goods: Rhee liked the cable. Now he wants it every month, and he has already written that down.
by.detour: Rhee's patrol walked the long way your handcars took, all the way to the end. Now he knows where it leads.

choices.label: Sign the ledger and pay (the Directorate is pleased)
Give him Fran's smuggling route instead (the Directorate is very pleased, the Exchange takes offence)
Bar the gate (the Directorate is furious)

title: Boots on the platform
text: Rhee's squad is on the platform. Jonah is watching them.

by.sign: Rhee is back early. His ledger says your station is behind on payments, and he has brought six men to read it out loud.
by.route: Fran's route is shut. Rhee's men used it to walk straight to your gate. Fran has not spoken to anyone since.
by.bar: Rhee's squad is on the platform. They did not knock. Jonah stands between them and the quarters.

choices.label: Pay what he asks (the Directorate is very pleased)
Ask Broker Lin to stand with you (the Exchange is pleased, the Directorate is not)
Put the platform guard at the gate (the Directorate is furious)

title: Knocking behind the rock
text: Lila's dig crew hears knocking behind the rock face: three slow, three fast. When they stop, it stops.

choices.label: Knock back
Cut toward the sound (the claustrophobic will refuse the shaft)
Fill the cut and say nothing

title: A hand through the gap
text: A woman has crawled through the rock in Lila's cut.

by.answer: The knocking answered for a week. Then the rock gave way and a woman crawled through, thin to the bone. She says she came up from the Floor.
by.cut: Lila's cut broke into a dry pocket. A woman was sitting in it with her lamp turned low. She says she came up from the Floor.
by.fill: The fill did not hold: someone dug through it from the other side. A woman, thin to the bone, says she came up from the Floor.

choices.label: Feed her and write down everything she says
Send her to the Synod's chapel (the Synod gains followers)
Send her back down and seal the gap

title: The woman from below
text: The woman from the Floor is back at your station, and she wants to talk to Paul.

by.feed: Three days of meals, and she has drawn a map on the back of a ration card. The Floor has power, she says, and it is not sharing. Paul recognises the first turn on it.
by.chapel: The Synod sent her back with a blessing and a map they could not read. Paul can. Your devout are already calling her a sign.
by.back: The seal broke from below. The same woman came through again, her hands torn on the rock. She has a map, she will not go back down, and Paul is already reading it.

choices.label: Give her a bunk
Send Paul's crew down her route
Walk her to the gate

title: Broker Lin's advance
text: Benny brings a note from Broker Lin. The Exchange will advance your station tokens now. In a few weeks it wants them back, with more on top.

choices.label: Take the advance (repay it with interest in a few weeks)
Thank her and decline (the Exchange takes offence)

title: Lin's collector
text: The Exchange's collector is waiting at Benny's handcar.

by.borrow: Lin's collector is at Benny's handcar with the note you signed. The interest is on top, as agreed.
by.decline: Lin's collector stops by Benny's handcar anyway. The Exchange remembers who turned its money down, and it would like a gesture of goodwill.

choices.label: Pay what Lin asks (the Exchange is pleased)
Give cable instead and ask for time (the Exchange is displeased)
Say the station has nothing to give (the Exchange may stop trading with you)

text.en: Bait opens the food store and the air inside is warm and sweet. The top row of sacks is turning. It will not keep another week.
text.ru: Наживка открывает продсклад, а оттуда тянет тёплым и сладким. Верхний ряд мешков пошёл. Ещё неделю не пролежит.

label.en: Sort it by hand and eat the edges

text.en: Salty Maggie knocks on the last fuel drum and it rings high. The generator will run tonight, but not at full.
text.ru: Солёная Мэгги стучит по последней бочке с соляркой, и та звенит высоко. Генератор сегодня поработает, но не в полную силу.

label.en: Buy a drum off the Exchange
Run it at half and dim the lamps

text.en: Old Man Coney caught Barnum leaving the kitchen with a ration inside his coat. Barnum says it was for Sylvia, who has been too sick to stand in line for two days. The whole platform saw it.
text.ru: Старик Кони поймал Барнума на выходе из кухни с пайком за пазухой. Барнум говорит, что нёс его Сильвии: она второй день не может выстоять очередь. Это видела вся платформа.

label.en: Dock Barnum's share for a week
Let it go and bring Sylvia her bowl
label.ru: Простить и носить Сильвии еду в койку

title: The man without an armband
text: Owen found a Directorate man asleep behind the generator. He took off his armband before he lay down. He asks not to be sent back to Captain Rhee.

choices.label: Give him a bunk and a new name (the Directorate is displeased)
Hand him back to the Directorate (the Directorate is pleased)
Feed him and point him north (the Directorate is displeased)

text.en: The bowls will not reach the end of the line. Someone eats full, or everyone eats less, or Bait goes to the Dead Pier for what the sea still holds.
text.ru: Мисок не хватит до конца очереди. Кто-то поест досыта, или все поедят меньше, или Наживка пойдёт на Мёртвый пирс за тем, что море ещё отдаёт.

label.en: Send Bait to the Dead Pier

text.en: Bowling Green will sell air, but not for kindness. They want hands, tokens, or a night you will not admit to.
text.ru: Боулинг-Грин продаст воздух, но не из доброты. Им нужны руки, жетоны — или ночь, в которой вы не признаетесь.

label.en: Lend two residents for four weeks
label.ru: Отдать двоих жителей на четыре недели

text.en: The cough has a list now. Seal them below, open every bed, or send three sick to the Slowwalkers at Flushing and hope the Synod still answers.
text.ru: У кашля теперь есть список. Запечатать их внизу, открыть все койки — или отправить троих больных к Медленным ходокам во Флашинг и надеяться, что Синод ещё отвечает.
